text: The future of artificial intelligence is a popular topic today. Many experts believe that general AI, which can do any mental task a human can do, will one day become a reality. This stronger form, called AGI, could bring great benefits, such as solving serious problems in medicine and science. However, it also carries risks, including job losses and safety concerns. Nobody agrees on when AGI might arrive. Some predict it within ten years, while others think it is much further away. Whatever happens, we need careful rules to make sure AI helps people and does not cause harm.
